decisions.reason: The published partition definition permits only positive parts and the empty partition. At r=1, lambda=(1), k=-1 the old target (0) was not an allowed Schur index; every normalized rational-weight index also had a trailing zero. Explicit zero removal now preserves the full twist range and rational classification, including empty outputs. Alternants use the restored padded coordinates, and tensoring by a character preserves irreducibility and shifts the highest weight.

Step 3.1 incorrectly asserted polynomial independence of r: for lambda=(1), mu=empty the right side is x_1 at r=1 and x_1+x_2 at r=2. The statement and conclusion already follow from F3 and step 2.1. The local proof correction states independence only of the coefficients and nonzero partition support; polynomial evaluations retain their rank-dependent variables. The top-row lattice-prefix argument proves nu_1<=lambda_1+mu_1, and distinct column-1 labels below ell(lambda) prove ell(nu)<=ell(lambda)+ell(mu), including empty inputs.
